sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Sharing the road
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Sharing the road

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Traffic in both directions must stop for a school bus with flashing red lights on every kind of road, lot and driveway, and only on an interstate is oncoming traffic across the median excused [A01].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty high; prereq sec12-F05; confusables sec12-F05, sec12-F06 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A05
Traffic does not have to stop for a public bus loading passengers, unlike a school bus, but must watch for passengers crossing and pass with caution [A05].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F32; confusables sec12-F05, sec12-F32 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A02
Headlights are dimmed within five hundred feet of an oncoming vehicle but within two hundred feet of a vehicle you are following [A02].
Why it matters: group headlights; difficulty high; prereq sec12-F11; confusables sec12-F11 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A02
Headlights must be on whenever people and vehicles cannot be seen clearly at five hundred feet, and in fog the low beams are used because high beams reflect back [A02].
Why it matters: group headlights; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F14; confusables sec12-F12, sec12-F14 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A04
After passing a truck in dry conditions allow two seconds before merging back to the right, but in wet conditions allow at least four to six seconds [A04].
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty high; prereq sec12-F25; confusables sec12-F25, sec12-F16 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A03
A fully loaded tractor-trailer at fifty-five miles per hour needs three times a car's stopping distance, and a typical heavy truck weighs eighty thousand pounds [A03].
Why it matters: group trucks; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F20; confusables sec12-F20, sec12-F21 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A03
You follow a motorcycle from farther back because it stops faster than a car, and when passing you move fully into the other lane and return only when well down the road [A03].
Why it matters: group motorcycles; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F18; confusables sec12-F17, sec12-F18 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A04
Animal riders share the rights and rules of motor vehicle users on most public highways but are barred from interstates, and a driver must never sound the horn near a horse [A04].
Why it matters: group animals; difficulty low; prereq sec12-F22; confusables sec12-F22, sec12-F01 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A05
A bicycle's bell must be audible at one hundred feet while its night headlight must be visible at five hundred feet, and a siren or whistle is never permitted on a bicycle [A05].
Why it matters: group bicycle-equipment; difficulty high; prereq sec12-F29; confusables sec12-F29 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A01
A blind pedestrian has the right-of-way when crossing with a white or metal cane, whether or not it has a red tip, or when led by a guide dog [A01].
Why it matters: group pedestrians; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F02; confusables sec12-F02, sec12-F03 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A01
Passing a stopped school bus costs at least sixty days of suspension plus a minimum five hundred dollar fine or up to six months in jail on a first offense [A01].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F08; confusables sec12-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A05
Bicyclists riding side by side must stay within one lane, a passenger rides only on an attached seat, and at least one hand always stays on the handlebars [A05].
Why it matters: group bicycle-rules; difficulty medium; prereq sec12-F27; confusables sec12-F27, sec12-F28 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0064]

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so its sharing-the-road pages change at most with a new edition.
